subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in present perfect continuous tense form

Rama is working on this project.

options.text: Rama has been working on this project since six months.
Rama has worked on this project for six months
Rama is working on this project for six months.
Rama has been working on this project for six months.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Rama has been working on this project for six months .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present continuous tense**, indicating an ongoing action.
 
• To convert it into the **present perfect continuous tense**, we use the structure **"has/have been + present participle (verb+ing)"**.
 
• When the duration of the action is mentioned (e.g., "for six months"), it confirms the use of the present perfect continuous tense.

Correct sentence: *Rama has been working on this project for six months*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Present Perfect Continuous Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure:** has/have been + present participle (verb+ing).
 
• **Example:** She has been reading for two hours.
 
• **Usage: **Describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing or has recently stopped, often with a focus on duration.
 
 
 
• **Present Perfect Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure: **has/have + past participle.
 
• **Example: **He has completed his homework.
 
• **Usage: **Describes an action that occurred at an unspecified time in the past and is relevant to the present.
